每个位置先查两张表，再逐项相加。这里的 48 个数就是这个词元进入模型时的表示。: Each position looks up two tables and adds them element by element. These 48 numbers are the token’s initial representation.
第一层接收嵌入向量，后续层接收上一层的输出。残差通路保留这份输入，等待逐项相加。: The first block receives embeddings; later blocks receive the preceding output. The residual path retains this input for elementwise addition.
在每个词元的 48 个特征内计算均值和方差，再乘上已训练的缩放与偏移。不会混合不: Compute mean and variance across each token’s 48 features, then apply trained scale and bias. Different positions are not mixed.
线性投影给每个头 16 个查询数。查询与可见位置的键做点积。这里每个小方格都是实: A linear projection produces 16 query values per head. Each query is dotted with keys at visible positions. Every cell is a computed value.
键由同一份归一化表示经过另一组已训练权重得到。它与查询的点积形成注意力分数。: Keys project the same normalised input through another trained weight set. Their dot products with queries form attention scores.
值是随后被加权汇总的内容。注意力分数决定各位置的权重，但不是模型思考过程的完整解: Values are the content later combined by attention weights. Attention sets the mixing coefficients, not a complete explanation of model reasoning.
每个查询只看当前和过去。未来位置被设为负无穷，经过 softmax 后权重恰好为: A query sees only its present and past. Future positions become negative infinity, giving exactly zero weight after softmax.
每一行的可见权重相加为 1。选择一个查询位置，看它怎样组合前面的值向量。连线粗细: Visible weights in each row sum to one. Select a query position to inspect how earlier value vectors are combined. Link widths use actual weights.
三个头各汇总 16 个数，再拼接回 48 维。关闭一个头会把它的这 16 维贡献: Each of three heads produces 16 values; concatenation restores 48 features. Muting a head zeros its 16-value contribution and recomputes the rest.
三个头的拼接结果经过线性投影，映射回残差通路的 48 个特征。: The concatenated heads are linearly projected back into the residual stream’s 48 features.
新算出的注意力结果逐项加回原始输入。选择一个单元，可以核对两项相加后的实际数值。: The attention result is added elementwise to the original input. Select a cell to inspect both terms and their actual sum.
前馈网络开始前，对每个位置的表示再次归一化。归一化参数与前一次独立训练。: Before the feed-forward network, normalise each position again with its own trained scale and bias.
每个位置独立地从 48 维扩展到 192 维。这一步不在位置之间交换信息。: Each position independently expands from 48 to 192 features. This step does not exchange information between positions.
逐元素应用 GELU。它改变正负输入的响应；如果所有步骤都是线性的，叠很多层仍只: Apply GELU elementwise. It changes the response to positive and negative inputs; a stack of purely linear transformations would still be linear.
192 个激活再投影回 48 维，与残差通路保持相同形状。: Project 192 activations back to 48 features so the result matches the residual stream.
本层的前馈结果加回残差通路，再交给下一层。三层依次使用不同的已训练权重。: Add the feed-forward result back into the residual stream and pass it to the next block. All three blocks have distinct trained weights.
最后一层之后，再做一次归一化，然后进入词表输出投影。: One final normalisation follows the last block, before projection into vocabulary scores.
每个位置得到 A、B、C 三个分数。它们还不是概率，也不必为正或相加等于 1。: Each position receives scores for A, B and C. These are not yet probabilities; they may be negative and need not sum to one.
这是温度为 1、没有 top-k 筛选的模型分布。右侧采样面板另外展示温度与筛选: This is the model distribution at temperature one with no top-k filtering. The sampling panel separately shows the adjusted distribution.
训练已经固定的查找表。改变输入会查不同的行，推理不会修改这里的权重。: A fixed, trained lookup table. Different input tokens select different rows. Inference does not change these weights.
同一矩阵存放所有头的查询、键和值投影。前三个 48 行分块分别对应 Q、K、V。: One matrix stores all heads’ query, key and value projections. Its three 48-row sections correspond to Q, K and V.
192 行已训练系数，把每个 48 维输入映射到扩展空间。每个格子都是公开文件里: The 192 trained rows map a 48-feature input into the expanded space. Every cell is a parameter from the published weight file.
扩展后的 192 个激活，通过这张已训练矩阵投影回 48 维。: This trained matrix projects the expanded 192 activations back into 48 features.
把最后的 48 个特征变成三个词表分数。这里只展示真实下载的小模型权重。: Map the final 48 features to three vocabulary scores. Only the small model’s actual downloaded weights are shown.
一次真实的计算，从词元到下一个词元。: One real calculation, from tokens to the next token.
只看当前与过去，组合不同位置的信息。: Mix information from the present and past.
48 维展开到 192 维，再回到残差通路。: Expand 48 features to 192, then return to the residual stream.
保留原来的表示，再把新结果加回来。: Keep the original representation and add the new result.
每一个格子，都能查到它的实际数值。: Every cell has a real value you can inspect.
可以旋转放大的真实 Transformer 计算结构: A real Transformer computation you can orbit and magnify
三维场景无法启动，仍可使用右侧数值实验。: The 3D scene could not start. The numerical labs remain available.
学会排序的微型 GPT: A tiny GPT trained to sort
这个模型的词表只有 A、B、C。六个输入之后，它预测排序输出；这里可以看见与 G: This model knows only A, B and C. After six inputs it predicts sorted output, exposing a real GPT-style computation.
六个字母已正确排序。: All six letters are correctly sorted.
这次采样没有得到正确排序。: This sample did not produce the correct sort.
改变温度会改变采样分布，不会修改权重。每次新增词元，都重新计算当前上下文。: Temperature changes sampling, not weights. Each new token triggers a fresh calculation over the current context.
可以点选单元的实际数值热图: Actual tensor values; click to select a cell
只列绝对贡献最大的八项；总和包含全部项。: Only the eight largest absolute contributions are listed; the sum includes every term.
关闭一个注意力头，或跳过一层前馈。保留原始权重，临时改变计算通路，再与完整模型的: Mute a head or skip an FFN. Keep the original weights, alter the calculation path temporarily, and compare against the same context in the complete model.
注意力连线不是完整的思想解释。干预显示这个小模型在这次输入上的变化，不能推广为所: Attention links do not fully explain reasoning. These interventions reveal this small model’s response to this input, not universal roles across all models.
拖动旋转 · 滚轮深入 · 点格子查数值: Drag to orbit · Scroll in · Select a numerical cell
Brendan Bycroft 发布、来自 minGPT 排序任务的微型 GPT: A tiny GPT published by Brendan Bycroft for minGPT’s sorting task: 3 blocks, 3 heads per block, 48 features, a 192-feature FFN, 11 context positions and 3 tokens, totalling 85,728 trainable parameters. These are trained weights.
六个输入字母之后，逐个生成六个排序字母。它没有聊天能力。最后一次预测使用 11: Six input letters are followed by six sorted letters, generated one at a time. It cannot chat. The final prediction uses 11 context tokens; the completed twelfth letter is not fed back into the model.
完整 JavaScript 前向计算在浏览器 CPU 上运行，三维场景展示实际张: The complete JavaScript forward pass runs on your browser’s CPU. The scene displays actual tensors. Slow-motion timing differs from computation time; colour, height, moving markers and space are reading aids.
与公开参考的三个样本、24 组中间张量逐元素对照，最大绝对误差低于 0.0000: Elementwise comparisons against three published samples and 24 intermediate tensors stay below 0.000003 maximum absolute error. At temperature zero, all 729 possible six-letter inputs sort correctly.
右列仅比较公开架构尺寸，没有下载或展示大模型权重。: The right column compares published architecture dimensions only. No large-model weights are downloaded or displayed.
权重、参考数值与许可随源码保留。三维画面和交互为本作品原创，不使用上游主页、字体: Weights, reference values and licenses accompany the source. The scene and interactions are original; no upstream homepage, fonts or images are used.
这份公开权重经过训练。给它六个 A、B、C，它逐个预测排序后的六个字母；本地运行: These published weights are trained. Enter six A/B/C letters and it predicts six sorted letters one at a time, locally, without a chat API.
点一个小格子，暂停演算并查看数值。也可以切到矩阵视图，把一张权重表放大到整个画面: Select a cell to pause and inspect its value, or magnify an entire weight table in the matrix view.
换一层、一个头或一个查询位置。未来位置的注意力为零，连线粗细来自实际权重。: Change the block, head or query position. Attention to future positions is zero; link widths reflect actual weights.
每个位置的 48 个特征独立扩展到 192 个，经过 GELU，再收回 48 个: Each position expands from 48 features to 192, passes through GELU, and returns to 48. Select a cell to inspect its dot product.
在实验面板关闭一个头或跳过一层前馈。后续数值与概率会真实重算，可以与完整模型比较: Mute a head or skip an FFN in the intervention panel. Downstream values and probabilities are recomputed for comparison with the full model.
恢复完整模型，改温度与 top-k，再生成一次。温度为零选最高分，较高温度会增加: Restore the full model, change temperature and top-k, then generate again. Zero temperature selects the highest score; higher temperatures give lower-scoring options more chance.
这个点积随后被因果掩码替换为负无穷。: The causal mask then replaces this dot product with negative infinity.
此层前馈输出已被干预置零；下方点积是置零之前的计算。: Intervention zeros this FFN output. The dot product below shows the computation before zeroing.
有符号数值按本矩阵归一化，概率固定为0到1；格子高度与空间距离为展示设计。: Signed values use this tensor’s range; probabilities use zero to one. Cell heights and spatial distances are display choices.
